detailed_description: The CSS Beautifier formats pasted CSS text in the browser. Choose an indentation option, then click Beautify to add simple line breaks and indentation around braces and declarations, or click Minify to remove comments and extra spacing around common CSS punctuation. The result appears in a readonly output textarea and can be copied. It is a lightweight text formatter and does not validate CSS syntax, guarantee standards compliance, parse every CSS edge case, or provide production build optimization.
usage_steps: Paste CSS into the input textarea.
Select the indentation option you want to use for beautified output.
Click Beautify for readable formatting or Minify for compact output.
Review the generated CSS in the output textarea and copy it when needed.
usage_examples: Example 1: Add line breaks and indentation to a compact CSS snippet before reviewing it.
Example 2: Remove comments and extra spacing from a small CSS block for a quick local test.
Example 3: Compare pasted CSS with the formatted output while checking selector structure.
Example 4: Copy a cleaned-up snippet into another editor after choosing an indentation size.
